# SeekTable

SeekTable is a business intelligence platform for creating, managing, and exporting reports, cubes, and dashboards.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/seek-table/.

## Actions

- **Export Report** (read-only): Export a saved SeekTable report in a selected file or data format.
- **Get Cube** (read-only): Get metadata for one SeekTable cube by its ID.
- **Get Report** (read-only): Get metadata and serialized configuration for one saved SeekTable report.
- **List Cubes** (read-only): List cubes in the connected SeekTable account, optionally filtering by provider source type.
- **List Reports** (read-only): List saved reports in the connected SeekTable account, including IDs needed by report detail and export tools.
